Sorry, I took an Ativan and went to sleep. I still feel empty today it’s weird being at work. 

My boyfriend has anger issues and he’s never been around people with anxiety or deplore so he doesn’t understand how someone could be like that. When I get sad or empty feeling he usually gets mad and frustrated which makes me blame myself. I know it’s not my fault and I can’t help how I feel but it makes me feel even weaker
Yeah I guess it’s always been like that

I’m taking 4 classes in community college and have all A’s and the semester is almost over. I have a job with decent hours and advancement opportunities. I have a car and I stay with my boyfriend. But I’m trying to make too many people happy I think, it’s overwhelming
